kept.name: qwen38-27b-200k-on-16gb
kept.reason: Step-by-step recipe for running Qwen 3.8 27B at about 196K context on a single 16 GB GPU, which is exactly the starting setup in the brief.

kept.name: llama-cpp-adaptive-kv-streaming
kept.reason: llama.cpp variant that keeps the context memory (KV cache) in system RAM and pages it in, so Qwen3.8-27B reaches 256K context on 16 GB of VRAM.

kept.name: kv-cache-vram-sizing
kept.reason: Formula and worked example for how much memory a given context length takes, which is key to choosing a model and context size for 16, 24 or 48 GB cards.

kept.name: large-moe-consumer-hardware
kept.reason: Guide to running large mixture-of-experts models on a 16 GB GPU with the experts kept in system RAM; includes memory budgeting and q8_0 context-memory sizing at 262K.

kept.name: strata
kept.reason: One-click engine for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (a 125B mixture-of-experts model) on 12–24 GB NVIDIA GPUs, with expert offloading to RAM and an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API.

kept.name: freetoken
kept.reason: Runs mixture-of-experts models larger than the GPU by keeping experts in system RAM; includes agentic context reuse and a compatible API, and uses the laptop's 64 GB of RAM.

kept.name: qwopus38-27b-flash
kept.reason: Variant of Qwen3.8-27B tuned for agent work (fewer runaway reasoning runs, better speculative-decoding acceptance), shipped as GGUF. A direct model candidate.

kept.name: qwen3-6-27b
kept.reason: Earlier 27B Qwen with 262K context and strong coding scores; a model candidate with notes on quantizing it for local use.

kept.name: local-model-picks-2026
kept.reason: Curated list of local models with their RAM/VRAM requirements, useful for picking a model at each card size.

kept.name: llmfit
kept.reason: Tool that detects your GPU and RAM and scores which models will fit and run well, including on context length.

kept.name: lm-studio
kept.reason: Desktop app that estimates whether a model fits in VRAM, controls GPU offload, and serves an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API for coding agents.

kept.name: unsloth
kept.reason: Source of the GGUF quantized models used in the Qwen 3.8 recipe, and offers an API endpoint for Claude Code and Codex.

kept.name: on-prem-llm-deployment-architecture
kept.reason: Reference on choosing hardware and serving software (vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama), with memory sizing that helps plan the 24/48 GB upgrade.

kept.name: ornith-dgx-spark-setup
kept.reason: Setup for serving a 35B mixture-of-experts model (3B active) at 262K context from a ~22 GiB checkpoint; a candidate for a 24/48 GB card.

kept.name: turboquant
kept.reason: 3–4-bit compression of the context memory (KV cache) with no reported accuracy loss, which directly stretches long context within limited VRAM.

kept.name: claude-code-local-model-switching
kept.reason: How to point Claude Code at a local Ollama or LM Studio server; includes a cache fix and a Qwen 3.6 35B config.

kept.name: free-claude-code
kept.reason: Proxy that sends Claude Code and Codex requests to local llama.cpp, Ollama or LM Studio backends.

kept.name: local-model-harness-patterns
kept.reason: Patterns for running local models as coding agents: subagents, loop detection with context cleanup, and speculative decoding.

kept.name: pi-coding-agent
kept.reason: Minimal coding-agent harness with a ~200-token system prompt; it leaves more of a local model's limited context for the actual work.

kept.name: local-model-adversarial-workflow
kept.reason: Workflow where a local Qwen 27B does planning and implementation and cloud models review; the same setup the brief describes.

kept.name: gvs5h-ledger-orchestration
kept.reason: Splits a coding task across fresh runs of Qwen3.8-27B that coordinate through shared files, lifting its LiveCodeBench Hard score from 69% to 92%; a strategy for getting more from a local model.

kept.name: prompt-assembly-cache-discipline
kept.reason: Rules for building prompts so the context cache keeps getting reused; important for long-context local agents where re-processing the prompt is slow.

kept.name: decomposition-over-context
kept.reason: Argues that breaking work into smaller tasks fixes agentic-coding limits better than bigger context windows; a relevant counterpoint for context-limited local setups.

kept.name: state-of-open-coding-models-2026
kept.reason: Sets expectations: the best open coding models no longer fit consumer hardware, which frames what is realistic at 16/24/48 GB.

kept.name: strata
kept.reason: (Listed above.) Supports multiple GPUs, so it also applies when moving to a 24 or 48 GB card.
